player.title: Player development report
player.desc: Record progress, celebrate strengths and agree on the next development focus.

Tactical: The player understands their position on the field.
In their position, do they understand where to position themselves according to which teammate has the ball? (Tactical decision)
In their position, do they understand where to position themselves according to which opponent has the ball? (Off-ball / Possession – Opponent)
The player is developing and learning their tactical role.
For their age, the player has a good understanding of their position on and off the ball.
Training: Does the player quickly understand the coach’s concepts?
Is the player learning to find self-motivation to train and learn the concepts at training?
Does the player try to excel in different activities?
Is the player competitive in various games?
Technical: Does the player have outstanding technique for their position?
Does the player use both feet to solve situations?
Does the player manage their body position correctly before receiving the ball?
Does the player have a good passing game?
Is the player developing and learning technical abilities?
Features: Is the player good at duelling? (1 v 1 or passing game)
Is the player fearless or willing to take risks?
Is the player responsible? (Uniform, schedules, game attendance)
Does the player accept the coach’s decisions?

fitness.title: Fitness report
fitness.intro: Build the engine. Support the player.
fitness.desc: Record observable fitness qualities and repeatable test results. Use the findings to plan appropriate training.

Habits: Uses correct technique in conditioning drills

tactical.title: Tactical report
tactical.intro: See the game. Make the difference.
tactical.desc: Assess decision-making in and out of possession, then choose clear tactical actions for the next session.

Possession: Chooses when to pass, carry or dribble
Maintains appropriate team width and depth
Defending: Applies pressure at the right moment
Transitions: Recognises when to counter-press or recover
Offers an outlet after regaining possession
Supports the team shape during transitions

parent.title: Parent report
parent.intro: A stronger connection. A happier player.
parent.desc: A parent or carer perspective on the player’s experience, enjoyment and support needs. Honest feedback helps the coaching team.

Experience: My child feels included in the team
My child feels comfortable asking the coach for help
Communication: I understand the training and match schedule
I receive timely and clear club updates
I understand my child’s development goals
I know how to contact the coaching team
Development: My child is growing in confidence
My child shows enthusiasm for football
My child is developing positive team habits
The programme supports my child’s learning

notes: What is working well for your child?
Questions or suggestions for the coaching team

coaches.title: Coaches report
coaches.intro: Reflect on the session. Raise the standard.
coaches.desc: Review coaching practice, session delivery and the team’s response. Record evidence and agree useful next steps.

Planning: Uses equipment, space and time effectively
Plans adaptations for different player needs
Delivery: Uses helpful questions and specific feedback
Adapts the session in response to learning
Environment: Creates an inclusive and supportive environment
Communicates professionally with families and staff
Reflection: Checks whether players understood the objective
Recognises what worked and what needs changing
Acts on feedback from other coaches
Sets a practical goal for the next session
